title: ‘Widow’s Bay’ Dominates, and 7 Other Takeaways From the 2026 Emmys
summary: The Apple TV horror-comedy about a haunted island took home 14 Emmys, including the awards for best comedy, lead actor, writing, directing and supporting actor and actress.
